meta.title: Harbour Jackpot: €1,000,000 starting jackpot, every Saturday at 21:00 | Harbour Play
meta.description: Harbour Jackpot is a weekly draw from Harbour Play, every Saturday at 21:00. Tickets are €3 and the jackpot starts at €1,000,000. 18+ only. Play responsibly.

hero.drawing: The draw is happening now. Results soon.

steps.title: Pick your numbers
steps.text: Choose 5 numbers from 1 to 45, and 1 Harbour Ball from 1 to 10. Or let us pick them for you.

steps.title: Buy your ticket
steps.text: Each line costs €3. Ticket sales close at 20:30 on Saturday.

steps.title: Watch the draw
steps.text: The draw is every Saturday at 21:00. Results appear on this page within minutes.

prizes.caption: Harbour Jackpot prizes for each line, and the odds of winning them
prizes.overall: Overall odds of winning any prize: 1 in {odds}.
prizes.rollover: If nobody wins the jackpot, it rolls over to the next Saturday.

results.heading: Latest results
results.jackpotWon: Jackpot won by {n} ticket. The next jackpot starts again at €1,000,000.

items.q: How much does a ticket cost?
items.a: Each line costs €3. You pick 5 numbers from 1 to 45 and 1 Harbour Ball from 1 to 10.
Every Saturday at 21:00, Malta time. Ticket sales close at 20:30, so make sure you buy before then.

items.q: How do I find out if I've won?
items.a: Results go live on this page and on the results page within minutes of the draw. If you bought your ticket online, we also email you.

items.q: What happens if nobody wins the jackpot?
items.a: The jackpot rolls over to the following Saturday and keeps growing until someone matches all 5 numbers and the Harbour Ball.

items.q: How do I claim a prize?
items.a: Prizes up to €1,000 are paid into your Harbour Play account automatically. For larger prizes, we contact you to confirm your identity before paying.
You must be 18 or over and in Malta to buy a ticket. We check your age and identity when you register.

items.q: Can I limit how much I spend?
items.a: Yes. You can set daily, weekly or monthly deposit limits, take a break, or exclude yourself in your account settings. Lower limits apply straight away. Higher limits apply after 24 hours.

safer.heading: Keep it fun
safer.body: A lottery is entertainment, not a way to make money or solve money worries. Only spend what you can afford to lose.

tools.title: Reality checks
tools.text: A reminder of how long you've been playing.

tools.title: Self-exclusion
tools.text: Close your account for 6 months or more.
